text: This is task 026 (what an interface call shows in the builder's tree), whose design part is open and waits for the person's word to start; rheotool-33 is added to its card as a fourth case, and its 'must not' now says B7 starts no engine in the builder's tree. The method recommended there covers it: a fixture call that needs the engine is not made in the tree, its verdict is read from the isolated copy's record, and without one it is not_run. Until it lands the fault stands. On the person's words in a blind clone: a blind clone has no docs/ideas by design, so keeping them verbatim in its intake card was right; the seat that reads the collection brings them to docs/ideas through the design role.
